    feat(bk7258): wifi scan works - 32 APs, recv_cnt=104, 1.61s
    
    Board result (sta-intcontract60m-20260902, broadcast `scan`):
      scanu_confirm: status=0 upload_cnt=104 recv_cnt=104 result=32 time=1.67s
      sd2 ind=104 done=1 ins=38 / sd5 exp=32
      isr 33=87 34=26 36=27        (was all 0 except a single 36=1)
      ke_sched[1..225]              (was only [1] in a whole 10s run)
      chan_survey on all 13 channels, 120 ms dwell each
      32 APs listed with BSSID/channel/RSSI/security/SSID
    
    Previously every scan ended in a 10 s host timeout with recv_cnt=0,
    zero MAC interrupts after init, and a ke event scheduler that ran
    fewer than 32 times per scan.
    
    The decisive change is most likely the sys_drv_int_* return contract.
    Authority sys_hal.c:745-793 has the disable variants return the ENTIRE
    enable register as it was BEFORE the clear, so a caller can restore
    exactly what it interrupted (rw_msg_tx/rw_task's WIFI_INT_DISABLE ..
    WIFI_INT_RESTORE pair feeds that value straight back to enable()).
    This port returned 0, turning any such restore into enable(0) - a
    permanent mask. That matches the observed symptom exactly: interrupts
    fired during init, then never again. Those two macros have no in-tree
    caller, but all four functions are reachable from the closed libwifi.a
    through the adapter table, where the pairing is invisible to us.
    The 60M vote landed in the same image, so single-variable attribution
    is not available; both are authority-derived and both stay.
    
    Changes, all derived by reading authority source rather than probing:
    
    - glue/hw_driver_shim.c: sys_drv_int_{disable,group2_disable} now return
      the pre-change enable register; explicit getreg32/putreg32 RMW under a
      spinlock. enable variants keep returning 0 (authority does too).
    - bk7258_wifi_lower.c: add the post-init 60M vote. Authority votes twice
      (bk_init.c:267 120M -> app_wifi_init -> :373 60M under
      CONFIG_CPU_DEFAULT_FREQ_60M=1), so init itself stays at 120M.
      Board confirms r0 0x33 -> 0x37, ckdiv_core 3 -> 7.
    - glue/include/common/sys_config.h: config alignment on three axes.
      P2P/WAPI_SUPPORT/FREERTOS_SMP are now UNDEFINED rather than 0, because
      `#define X 0` still satisfies `#ifdef X` and was compiling code the
      authority never builds. WIFI4/STA_AUTO_RECONNECT/WIFI_SCAN_COUNTRY_CODE/
      SCAN_SPEED_LEVEL aligned to authority values after checking that every
      block they switch on resolves here. LWIP/SHELL_ASYNCLOG/
      VNET_CONTROLLER documented as deliberate divergences.
    - glue/include/common/bk_typedef.h: add cpu_to_le32 (only le16 existed;
      CONFIG_WIFI4=1 needs it for the VHT branch of ME_CONFIG_REQ).
    - glue/rtos_compat_shim.c, glue/os_shim.c: ke_malloc and
      os_malloc_wifi_buffer zero their allocations. The closed library has
      code that allocates then assumes zero (proven for sta_info_tab);
      FreeRTOS hides it because its heap is a .bss array, NuttX's heap is
      already dirty by Wi-Fi init. Not a claim that FreeRTOS guarantees zero.
    - glue/pbuf_shim.c: fix two stacked pbuf ABI violations - the layer
      switch was off by one so BK_PBUF_RAW fell through to NULL, and
      get_rx_pbuf_type returned an lwIP bitfield where an ordinal was due.
    - third_party/.../rwnx_td.c: restore the authority's RWNX_LOGE + BK_ASSERT(0)
      on pkt_cnt underflow; the adaptation had reduced it to a silent return.
      Also restore the rwnx_defs.h include it had dropped.
    - Probe migration: sa_station.c is back to byte-identical vendor source,
      rw_msg_tx.c keeps four one-line latch calls. All probe logic, storage
      and formatting moved to glue/scan_diagnostics.c (bk7258_hwprobe_*).
      Vendored drift vs the pristine drop is down from 259 to 171 lines.
    - hal_port/{hal_port_dvfs,hal_port_mac,hal_port_sys_int_power}.c: new,
      carrying the authority-derived DVFS, MAC-address and IRQ-bank/power
      sequences out of the shim layer.
    
    Note: the hp0/hp1 latch columns say nothing about MM bring-up.
    mm_start_req_handler sends its CFM before calling mm_active(), so ke=0
    and r38=0 at those sample points is the expected success path; the
    comment in bk7258_wifi_lower.c now warns against the reading a previous
    revision of it asserted.

    feat(bk7258): 4-way handshake now starts - EAPOL demux, msg dispatch, table parity
    
    Board-verified progression this session, from "association is never confirmed"
    to "ASSOCIATED reached, M1 received, PTK derived, M2 built". Four separate
    port-side divergences were found and fixed; each one compiled and linked
    cleanly before, and only failed at run time.
    
    1. rw_task.c: the non-PM_V2 core_thread_main() lacked BMSG_SOFTWARE_IOCTL_TYPE
       and BMSG_HARDWARE_IOCTL_TYPE cases, so ME_GET_BSS_INFO_REQ (routed to the
       hardware sender by rw_msg_tx.c:112-118) fell into `default` and was dropped.
       ME_GET_BSS_INFO_CFM never returned, rw_msg_send timed out after 5 s,
       wpa_drv_get_bssid() failed, and wpa_supplicant_event_assoc() deauthenticated
       locally before it could set state ASSOCIATED. Both cases were moved verbatim
       from the PM_V2 sibling variant; the vendor default config (bk7258.defconfig
       :171 CONFIG_PM_V2=y) is why upstream never hits this.
       Board: `rw_msg_send timeout for 6173` and `Failed to get BSSID` gone,
       ASSOCIATED reached 4/5 attempts, then 3/3.
    
    2. bk7258_wifi_lower.c ethernetif_input(): EAPOL (0x888E) was handed to the
       NuttX stack with every other 802.3 frame and dropped there, so the 4-way
       handshake never began. Now split off to ke_l2_packet_tx() ahead of the netif
       path, transcribed from the vendor bridge (cp/.../port/wlanif.c:331) including
       its self-echo filter. This obligation was already recorded and unimplemented
       in glue/include/wpa_compat/sk_intf.h:20-22.
       Board: `ASSOCIATED -> 4WAY_HANDSHAKE`, `WPA: RX message 1 of 4-Way
       Handshake`, PTK/KCK/KEK/TK derived, `Sending EAPOL-Key 2/4`.
    
    3. bk_prelude.h + log.h + main_supplicant.c: CONFIG_WPA_LOG was undefined, so
       build_config.h:174 suppressed wpa_printf/wpa_dbg/wpa_msg entirely and the
       association path failed silently. Selecting the full tier is what made (1)
       and (2) findable. Two consequences handled: BK_LOGV is now compiled out,
       because wifi_v2.c:2781/2828 print the passphrase in the clear on this exact
       path and the authority never emits them (its BK_LOG_LEVEL is INFO, so BK_LOGV
       expands empty); and wpa_debug_show_keys is 0 so hexdump_key prints [REMOVED].
    
    4. bk7258_wifi_adapter.c: os_funcs table brought to slot parity with the
       authority adapter (276 = 276, no difference either way).
       - _flush_all_dcache was an empty stub while CONFIG_ARCH_DCACHE=y on both
         sides; now Clean+Invalidate as the authority does
         (cp/middleware/arch/cm33/cache.c:37-42). glue/include/cache.h:12-16 warned
         this was "silent data corruption on the MAC data path".
       - _pm_low_voltage_delta_wakeup_delay_in_us 0 -> 188, the authority's
         ceil(6*1e6/32000) from sys_types.h:115-130.
       - _delay / _rc_drv_set_rf_en / _sta_ip_start reverted to NULL: the authority
         leaves all three empty and runs, so the library skips them; ours filled
         _delay with a millisecond sleep of guessed units on the core thread, which
         would stall CFM processing if the library ever used it.
    
    Supporting changes: connect shims (bk7258_wifi_sta_connect/_status/_is_connected
    plus state/reason decoders) transcribed from the authority's own caller
    demo_sta_app_init (wifi_api.c:185-210), with bounded copies instead of its
    unbounded os_strcpy because our input is a command line; `connect <ssid> <psk>`
    subcommand on the existing 8 KiB kthread path, credentials via argv only and
    never logged; sta_ip_mode_set and hostapd_channel_switch(+_stop) added for
    linkage once the previously dead vendor code went live; OSAL semaphore waits
    switched to the _uninterruptible variants so EINTR is not reported to the vendor
    as a timeout (xSemaphoreTake has no such outcome); pbuf_free() aligned with
    lwIP refcount semantics on chained pbufs.
    
    Three bring-up probes remain and must be removed once the handshake closes:
    `evtq` (wpa_queue_shim.c), `txq miss` and `l2tx cfm` (rwnx_tx.c), plus the
    rw_task.c dropped-message log.
    
    Current state: M2 is built and submitted but reported unacknowledged
    (`__l2_packet_send: send failed` x3, then psk_mismatch, which is the local
    give-up rather than a wrong key). rwnx_select_txq succeeds (no `txq miss`), so
    the open question is the TX confirmation itself.

`wifi-rebuild` worktree 对应的是 `bk7258-hal-alignment` 分支，当前在 `c87fecb`。本周 Wi‑Fi bring-up 的进展很明显，但还不能报“Wi‑Fi 已可用”。

已取得的实板进展：

- 扫描已通：记录为 32 个 AP、`recv_cnt=104`，约 1.67 秒完成。
- STA 已能关联到 AP，状态达到 `ASSOCIATED`。
- EAPOL 分流和 4-way handshake 已启动：收到了 M1，已派生 PTK/KCK/KEK/TK，并构造、提交了 M2。
- 本周修复了几类此前只会在运行期暴露的问题：中断 mask 恢复契约、非 `PM_V2` 消息分发遗漏、EAPOL 被错误交给 NuttX 网络栈、OS 函数表与 vendor adapter 的 slot 对齐、cache flush 等。
- 当前 HEAD 相对 `dev` 多 39 个提交，Wi‑Fi 相关工作量已成体系，不是零散试验。

当前核心阻塞：

- M2 发送后三次均未获得 TX confirmation（记录为 `acked=0`）；因此尚未完成握手，更没有 `CONNECTED` 或 DHCP 成功证据。
- 现阶段最应聚焦 TX confirmation / MAC 发送完成路径，而不是继续改关联或 EAPOL 接收逻辑。
- `psk_mismatch` 目前被判断为本地超时放弃后的表象，但尚没有足够独立证据排除真实密码或 AP 侧因素。
- CP 配置已在未提交改动中打开完整 runtime，但文档明确说 CP 镜像尚未完成打包、烧录；目前的板端结果不能外推为 CP 交付结果。

分支与交付风险：

- 分支相对远端是“领先 37、落后 33”，相对 `dev` 也落后 1 个提交，已明显分叉；当前不适合直接视为可合并或最新基线。
- worktree 还有 5 个未提交文件，主要是 CP/runtime-probe 配置以及能力状态文档。它们描述了扫描、关联和 M1/M2 的成果，但也承认未联网。
- 这次核查看到的是提交说明和状态文档，没有发现可独立复核的完整 UART 原始日志、固件哈希、烧录命令与结果包。因此这些板端结论应视为当前团队记录，尚未达到规范要求的可审计硬件验收证据。

一句话总结：本周从“扫描不通、关联起不来”推进到了“扫描稳定、关联成功、4-way 收到 M1 并发出 M2”；下周的关键目标是拿到 M2 TX completion，随后验证握手完成、获取 IP 和实际网络连通性。
